'''January 2003 Beaverton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held on Saturday 11 January 2003 at the Willow Springs Apt Community Center, 3240 SW Doyle Place, Beaverton, Oregon. It was one of [[Glenn Hall]]'s tournaments, held the same day as his [[Young Jedi]] tournament, and [[David Kangas]] announced both.<ref name="pcf-622-9356">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=9356#9356 YJ in Beaverton, OR], David Kangas, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 January 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050215052836/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=622%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Willow Springs Apt Community Center, 3240 SW Doyle Place, Beaverton, Oregon<ref name="pcf-622-9356" />
* '''Dates:''' 11 January 2003, 2:00 PM<ref name="pcf-622-9356" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Glenn Hall]]<ref name="pcf-622-9356" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="pcf-622-9356" />

The Young Jedi tournament started at 11:00 AM, with an entry fee of $2.50 or $6 for different prizes.<ref name="pcf-622-9356" />
